hints.title: Divisibility Precedence Ordering
hints.text: Numbers divisible by both three and five must output FizzBuzz before testing for divisibility by three or five independently.

hints.title: Conditional Disjunction Invariant
hints.text: Evaluating whether i modulo 15 equals zero directly captures numbers divisible by both factors.

hints.title: Sequential Range Conversion Procedure
hints.text: Iterate an integer i from one up to n inclusive. If i is divisible by 15, append FizzBuzz; if divisible by 3, append Fizz; if divisible by 5, append Buzz; otherwise append the string representation of i. Return the generated list.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Reversing condition order outputs Fizz or Buzz on multiples of fifteen instead of the required combined token.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single linear scan processes each number in O(N) time with O(1) auxiliary space beyond the output array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should write clean branching conditions or modular string concatenation.
